covers: WF-04 — 'Addressables + R2 remote catalogs (Lane P)' (parent MST-W4-12, Wave 4, Step 87, M1; fixer muse-b7; author of record muse-b9 per the Concordia tranche seating). Dependency P0-04 (the asset rail) landed on v1/concordia-pf @ 0b9612ee8 and its recipe was registered by muse-b7 @ b167a8357; the office ruled NO SPLIT (no settings-only partial), so the whole ticket built once the rail stood. Build: ONE commit 197ef2b5b on v1/concordia-wf (the branch's twentieth, over MU-M09), 6 files, +422/-0: (1) Packages/manifest.json declares com.unity.addressables 2.2.2 (the Unity-6 line; the exact patch resolves at editor import, desk-verified); (2) NEW Assets/Concordia/Editor/World/AddressablesBootstrap.cs — deterministically creates/re-asserts the Addressables settings: remote catalog ON with Remote build/load paths, the TileGroups-Remote group (PackTogether, LZ4, CanChangePostRelease off), the 'tiles' label, and idempotent assignment of every baked tile under TerrainTileBaker.OutputRoot (WF-03) with labels tiles + tiles/<landFolder>; (3) NEW Assets/Concordia/Scripts/World/TileGroupCatalog.cs — the runtime loader behind the plan flag cf.world.addressables (PlayerPrefs int, default OFF): LoadTileGroup(label tiles/<landFolder>) with a handle cache (a second load is a CacheHit, counted), ReleaseTileGroup, and named failures (LastError + LogError, never silent); (4) scripts/concordia/verify-addressables.mjs, the headless pin. The catalog load path is ONE desk-owned profile value — interim '{UnityEngine.Application.streamingAssetsPath}/ConcordiaCatalog' (the catalog served beside the build from the rail's local store); R2 is PARKED (founder Q2, per ASSET_RAIL.md), and un-parking replaces that single value with the bucket URL — no code changes. BuildAssets.cs is BYTE-UNTOUCHED (the verifier pins its sha against the base): the ticket's 'BuildAssets.cs path kept behind the flag' is literal — with the flag off, that path is the route exactly as before. NOT CLAIMED at this seat: the WebGL acceptance execution itself (a build loads a tile group; second load from cache) is desk/editor-side, as with WF-03's bake; the ASSET_MANIFEST's current 223 rows are all animations/mixamo — tile-group ENTRIES appear when baked tiles are assigned by the bootstrap at build time (P0-07 grows the catalog further). Consumers: WF-05 (tile streamer, depends on WF-04) and PF-06 (download budget, depends on WF-04).

steps: In the Unity editor on the batch build, run Concordia/World/Addressables Bootstrap (WF-04) (or the batchmode entry Concordia.EditorTools.AddressablesBootstrap.BootstrapBatch): the settings exist with the remote catalog on, the TileGroups-Remote group is remote-pathed, and baked tiles are assigned with tiles/<landFolder> labels.
Build the WebGL client and serve it with the catalog published at the profile load path (interim: StreamingAssets/ConcordiaCatalog from the rail store).
Set the plan flag cf.world.addressables ON (PlayerPrefs int 1) and load a tile group through TileGroupCatalog.LoadTileGroup(<landFolder>): the group's tiles arrive from the remote catalog and render.
Load the same tile group again: TileGroupCatalog.CacheHits increments and no new catalog fetch is issued — the second load comes from cache.
Read-back: ReleaseTileGroup drops the group; IsLoaded reports false; the load can be repeated from the catalog.
title: WF-04: a WebGL build loads a tile group from the Addressables remote catalog (the P0-04 rail's serving face) behind cf.world.addressables; the second load comes from cache and BuildAssets is untouched
